insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 47% women's / 35% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 20% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (13%) is NaN% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (186) vs Lululemon (205). Gap of 19 to close.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 43% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1877 vs 1286 products. A 46% advantage.
Vuori ranks #2 in shorts with 891 products. Behind Gymshark (1994).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 767 products vs Lululemon's 680. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 51,276 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 5,413 = 10% share of tracked catalog.
